_comment: PROPOSAL ONLY - READ-ONLY ASSESSMENT. Do not apply without explicit approval.
Least-privilege CloudFormation Service Role for the divine-printing-cognito-v2 stack.
This role would be passed to CloudFormation at change-set creation time via --role-arn.
Associating a service role with an existing stack requires an UPDATE change-set with
--role-arn specified. This permanently associates the role until it is explicitly removed.
PERMANENT STACK ASSOCIATION REQUIRES EXPLICIT APPROVAL before execution.
Why a service role matters:
- Without a service role, CloudFormation uses the caller's credentials to provision
resources. This means the openclaw-automation caller needs direct IAM permissions
for every resource type in the stack (DynamoDB, Lambda, Cognito, API Gateway, IAM).
- With a service role, the caller only needs cloudformation:CreateChangeSet,
cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet, cloudformation:Describe*, and iam:PassRole.
All resource-level actions are performed by the service role, not the caller.
- This follows the principle of least privilege for human/automation operators.
Scoped to the two-stage Sprint 4 import-and-update workflow:
Stage 1 (IMPORT change-set): Adopts CustomersTableV2 into stack management.
Stage 2 (UPDATE change-set): Cognito User Pool hardening, Groups creation,
AppClient update, AutoConfirmFunction + AutoConfirmPermission removal.
Legacy DynamoDB tables, LambdaExecutionRole, other Lambda functions, and
API Gateway are semantically unchanged (zero-unintended-diff policy).
Usage (after approval):
aws cloudformation create-change-set \
--stack-name divine-printing-cognito-v2 \
--role-arn arn:aws:iam::911762440868:role/divine-printing-cfn-service-role \
--change-set-name ... \
--template-body file://...
Trust policy - allows CloudFormation service to assume this role.
Conditions restrict trust to the specific stack ARN and source account,
preventing confused-deputy attacks from other stacks or accounts.
Permissions policy scoped to exactly the resource types and ARN patterns
required for the two-stage Sprint 4 import-and-update workflow:
- CustomersTableV2 IMPORT (describe + tag only; no creation/deletion)
- Cognito User Pool update, Groups create/update/delete, AppClient update
- AutoConfirmFunction and AutoConfirmPermission removal (Lambda delete actions)
- IAM read-only on LambdaExecutionRole (unchanged; CloudFormation drift-check only)
- No ApiGateway permissions (no API Gateway resources changed in this workflow)
- No legacy DynamoDB table permissions (not being modified by this update)
- No s3:* or logs:* (not required for this specific service role purpose)
- No cognito-idp:CreateUserPool or cognito-idp:DeleteUserPool (updating existing pool)
- iam:PassRole is omitted: no new Lambda execution role is created or modified
through this stack update (existing LambdaExecutionRole is unchanged).
